static_traits.name: Chen Di
static_traits.family_status: Lives with parents and younger brother; family is supportive but has limited understanding of her social difficulties
static_traits.social_status: In the new job finds it hard to build friendships with colleagues, daily socializing affected; family can provide emotional support but suggestions are rather general
static_traits.medical_history: Past similar difficulties in socializing due to Asperger's; received counseling and social skills training; no significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, highly cooperative; able to identify and describe one's own automatic thoughts; easily nervous in group settings, tongue-tied; tending to literal understanding of social cues

basic_info.main_problem: I tend to understand things too literally in social situations, especially in the new work, making it hard to make friends; the problem has developed to making me feel isolated at work, believing the workplace may be unfriendly.
basic_info.core_demands: Realized that difficulty making friends at the new job affects overall happiness and job satisfaction; hopes to learn to better read social cues and obtain concrete, operable social strategies.
growth_experiences: Past similar difficulties in social or new environments due to Asperger's, manifesting as literal understanding of social information, struggling with small talk and team activities; received counseling and social skills training for this.
Overall family support, but limited understanding of the complexity of the social challenges, with rather general advice, sometimes making one feel not understood enough.

core_beliefs: I do not fit in / am disliked
I am flawed socially and prone to saying the wrong things

special_situations.event: Colleagues joking in a team meeting, most people laughing, but oneself not understanding and not yet joining in
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot understand and respond to humor promptly, colleagues will see me as strange and exclude me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: In meetings, keeps silent or reluctantly agrees, reducing speaking to avoid making mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They noticed I'm not laughing, think I'm strange, and are judging me

special_situations.event: Still having not yet made friends after some time on the job
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot build relationships in a short time, it means this place is overall unfriendly or I am not accepted
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Attributing the cause to the unfriendly environment, reducing the frequency of taking initiative to connect
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is not a friendly work place

special_situations.event: Being called on to speak in group settings or suddenly asked to express views
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I say one wrong thing, everyone will not like me and will not want to talk to me in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly weighing word choices, hesitating to speak or keeping expressions short to lower the chance of mistakes
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will say the wrong thing, and everyone will not like me for it

special_situations.event: Still not yet seeing obvious improvement after multiple attempts at small talk and joining team activities
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If trying a few times has no effect, it means I cannot do it, and making friends is either success or failure for me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Gradually reduces trying or maintains mechanical participation to avoid frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nothing I do works, I just cannot make friends

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted by peers, build friendships, and be seen as interesting and approachable
core_conflict.fear: Fears being judged, rejected, and humiliated, appearing 'strange' in groups or being excluded
defense_goal: Avoids being judged by keeping a low profile and reducing exposure
Attributing difficulties to the environment to lessen self-blame and anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: Not fitting in, an outsider prone to mistakes and embarrassment
object_relations.object_representation: Picky, judgmental, and not very friendly colleagues

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor explores 'whether colleagues are really judging them' and invites considering others' perspectives or objective evidence
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to project inner unease and self-doubt onto others, believing others notice and negatively evaluate oneself (transference: seeing others as potential judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: With a gentle tone, validating the feelings, inviting evidence and counter-evidence; proposing concrete observable cues (such as others' behavior, tone), avoiding confrontational negation, encouraging small-step experiments to test hypotheses.

manifestations: Finds it hard to make friends at the new workplace; hard to fit into team jokes
Often feeling 'not fitting in', tongue-tied in group settings, out of place
Feels lacking in social energy even outside work

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: In group settings, highly worries about 'saying the wrong thing', over-deliberating wording and becoming tongue-tied
Frequently self-evaluates 'I am awkward / always say the wrong thing', reduces spontaneous expression

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Automatically assuming others notice and negatively evaluate oneself when not yet getting the joke in meetings
Interpreting not yet building friendships promptly as 'the workplace is unfriendly / colleagues do not like me'

positive_force: Overall family support, willing to listen
The client is well motivated, positive attitude, willing to try new strategies and feedback
Previously received social skills training, with some learning foundation
Able to notice and describe automatic thoughts, with potential for reflection and correction
negative_force: Tending to literal understanding of social cues, prone to mind-reading, overgeneralization, and all-or-nothing thinking
High worry about being judged/rejected, easily nervous and tongue-tied in group situations
Externally attributing short-term setbacks to 'unfriendly environment', weakening self-efficacy
Energy drained by social pressure, further reducing social investment and practice opportunities

target_behavior.behavior: When speaking in a group or being called on, shows marked tension and speechlessness, avoiding or extremely simplifying expression
antecedent: Being called on to speak on the spot in team meetings / group settings
Situations where many people are present at once, with joking or relaxed interaction
target_behavior.core_reason: High sensitivity to being judged/rejected and catastrophic anticipation (social-cue processing difficulty related to Asperger's)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding potential negative evaluation and embarrassment, to lower anxiety in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Missing opportunities to show oneself and interact, feeling further isolated, declining work performance and satisfaction

target_behavior.behavior: In daily small talk and team activities, tends toward mind reading and negative prediction, leading to tense avoidance and reduced interaction
antecedent: Small talk with colleagues, small-group collaboration, informal exchanges
target_behavior.core_reason: Literal understanding of social cues and negative interpretation bias, reinforcing the assumption that 'others do not like me'
target_behavior.function: Seeks psychological safety and a sense of certainty by reducing self-exposure
target_behavior.consequence: Friendship building is blocked, subjective isolation intensifies, affecting work engagement and emotional state
